enemy-053-albino-ovomorph.method: Lower-shell center measured from the median centers of occupied scanlines in the bottom45 source pixels, excluding the last8 edge pixels; individually reinspected on the four source boards and corresponding marked overlays. Physical support is the exact visible lower shell edge (exclusive pixel boundary), not the extractor's additional3 transparent pixels. Landmark is60px above that support within lower shell/remains. Uncertainty +/-4 source pixels. Every pose is grounded; terminal destroyed poses use the center/support of flattened remains. This reviews registration only, not art acceptance. OpeningR1 was rejected for a lower-shell jump; openingR2 is measured here anew without carrying old source coordinates forward.
